description: If you’ve ever tried to repurpose a clip from TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or Snapchat, you’ve probably run into the same problem: the original watermark, text overlay, or logo is burned into the video. A lot of “free” editors can hide those elements by smearing a blur box over them—but blur ruins the look of your content and can make the video feel low-quality (especially on modern 1080p feeds).
